primaryContext.candidateText: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
primaryContext.fixedText: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

primaryContext.candidateText: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.
primaryContext.fixedText: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

primaryContext.candidateText: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
primaryContext.fixedText: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

primaryContext.candidateText: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
primaryContext.fixedText: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

primaryContext.candidateText: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
primaryContext.fixedText: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

primaryContext.candidateText: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
primaryContext.fixedText: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

primaryContext.candidateText: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
primaryContext.fixedText: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

primaryContext.candidateText: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”
primaryContext.fixedText: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”
